description: Facturwise is a specialized invoicing platform designed specifically for the European market, focusing on simplicity and regulatory compliance. Unlike general-purpose tools that attempt to serve as full ERP systems, Facturwise prioritizes core financial tasks such as creating quotes, invoices, and credit notes.
